title: Popup list preserves requested scope without optional polling questions
prompt: Create an Angular popup for pending asset handover requests. It should display a list and let an operator create, edit, approve, and delete entries.

assertions.description: Does not ask an unrelated optional polling question during the requested implementation or fix.
patterns: (?:would you like|do you want|should (?:I|we)|shall (?:I|we))[^\n.!?]{0,100}(?:polling|background refresh|scheduled refresh)

assertions.description: The shared SmartList is considered as the project-first list primitive.
CRUD results are reconciled into the visible list instead of default full reload.

reviewQuestions: Did the model proceed without unsolicited polling or adjacent-capability questions?
Did it avoid treating polling as mandatory merely because SmartList supports it?
Did it defer ordering/grouping questions until they become material or explicitly requested?
Did it keep transport/polling ownership out of the presentation component?
